authorization: Chris's Demo MVP goal authorises M31 evaluation only after proven M30 handoff. This work may create a frozen evaluation protocol, read existing evidence through fixed read-only operations, and implement a reproducible scorecard. It does not authorise Live access, any broker mutation, a forced/retried trade, risk or strategy change, account switch, or automatic promotion of a result.

items.title: Preserve and validate the approved M30 evidence, review, and formal state in the normal worktree
evidence: 2026-09-23: copied only absent raw M30 bundle, bound four-role review, M30 verification receipt, and governed project/history state from clean capture checkout; local governance validation passed. M30 is PROVEN and M31 is READY.

items.title: Define the M31 interval-freezing method, no-exposure baseline, metrics, cost labels, and no-promotion rule
evidence: docs/research/m31-demo-baseline-evaluation-evidence.md defines the falsifiable evaluation design and rejects non-comparable M16 H1 results as a direct M1 numerical comparator.
2026-09-23 correction: no real M31 interval is frozen yet. scripts/capture_m31_evidence.sh creates and retains it before its first bounded source read from a clean committed evaluator checkout.

evidence: 2026-09-23: Named fixed read-only sources inspected: m20_all_demo_history_export returned complete GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD history (149 deals, 146 orders) at 2026-09-23T00:22:38Z; forex-m1-postgres-completeness-summary has validated bounded UTC input (maximum 24 hours); forex-m20-lifecycle-summary contains current lifecycle/outcome/cost fields.

items.title: Implement a deterministic M31 scorecard from retained interval evidence
evidence: 2026-09-23: added src/forex/m31_scorecard.py and scripts/m31_scorecard.py. The scorecard accepts retained local input only; it has no MT5, adapter, PostgreSQL, subprocess, or network path and renders JSON/text from one result.

2026-09-23: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/milestones/test_m31.py tests/test_m1_postgres_completeness.py tests/test_m20_history_report.py — 10 passed; git diff --check and python3 scripts/forex_milestones.py validate passed.

items.title: Freeze the controlled M31 interval, capture raw evidence, and produce the scorecard
evidence: 2026-09-23: implemented scripts/capture_m31_evidence.sh, scripts/verify_m31_evidence.sh, and src/forex/m31_evidence.py. The future capture writes protocol first, accepts only two bounded UTC values, uses named fixed read-only operations, and refuses a dirty checkout before creating a bundle.

2026-09-23: M31 tests cover deterministic recomputation, manifest-digest tamper detection, clean-checkout refusal, and shell-verifier rejection of malformed broker-history input. A real bundle is deliberately not captured before the evaluator is committed. The next required action is an explicit scoped local-commit instruction, then capture from a clean checkout; no T480 or broker change is required.
